data.title: 神尾观铃 · 蝉鸣缘侧的千头恐龙与嘎嗷
data.description: 神尾家老屋长长的木制缘侧上，檐角铜风铃清脆作响。观铃抱着巨大的千头龙毛绒玩偶，靠在柱子边大口打着哈欠，双手握拳举在颊边可爱的“嘎嗷~”。
data.location: traditional wooden Japanese engawa porch overlooking sunlit yard with fluttering wind chime
data.action: sitting on wooden porch holding an oversized green dinosaur plushie, making cute roaring fists by cheeks with a sleepy happy grin
data.lighting: 庭院树荫洒下的柔和斑驳午阳
data.promptProse: Misuzu sits on her wooden porch hugging a giant green dinosaur plush, striking a playful "Gao" pose with a sleepy, cheerful yawn.
data.animaCaption: Gentle summer breeze stirs the porch windchime as she hugs her plushie with a happy grin.
